svg.text: Safety circuit – F-PLC, e-stops, door, light curtain, STO
T1 / T2 test pulses of -KF21 (stationary F-DI) and -KF23 (crane F-DI) – drawn as one pair
safety program (F-blocks): ESTOP1, F-door + guard locking,
muting (2 sensors, time window), SLS/SSM, ACK = reset
Cat 3 · PL d (ISO 13849-1) · PROFIsafe over PROFINET + DDLS
